integrity: All algebraic assertions are proved from conditional spherical moments and the beta-density differentiation identity. Numerical checks are corroboration, not proof. Novelty is assessed against accessible sources only; no independent validation or absolute-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact-degree-two homogeneous scalar spherical harmonics on \(S^{d-1}\), for every integer \(d\ge3\); observation is intrinsic-gradient energy on two antipodal caps, with \(0<t<1\). No other degrees, single asymmetric caps, finite sampling, noisy-data stability or dimension-uniform small-cap asymptotics are claimed.
title: A dimension-free optimizer switch for tangential-gradient concentration of spherical quadrupoles
